data.name: Thanks-A-Ton
data.pathway_secondary: DAC; Biochar; Mineralization; Afforestation; Ocean CDR
data.description: Thanks a Ton is a B2C/B2B platform that pairs custom digital greeting cards with bundled carbon dioxide removal credits sourced from vetted third-party CDR suppliers (Climeworks, Charm Industrial, CarbonCure, Living Carbon, Nori, SeaGen, and others). The company does not itself remove CO2; it is a retail reseller/marketplace channel aimed at making CDR accessible to consumers and small businesses through gifting.
